name: ugot-skills
description: UGOT's open skills for Claude Code and Codex: agent mindset gates, reader-first writing, engineering habits.

plugins.name: ugot-mindset
plugins.description: How the agent should think and talk with the user: read the intent, declare requirements before the first tool call, verify before claiming, picture first, blame the instrument before the result, solve before saying impossible, keep going, brief human answers; seven pre-output decisions (persona, lens, sources, KPIs, 5W1H, format, constraints), shorten dated plans by harvesting what others already solved, persuade with the intent lineage. 41 skills, 2 agents and automatic prompt/result/stop/bash gates. 0.8.35: notice-the-drift — a mid-turn noticing channel (drift-gate: the user's goal line + three questions every 8 tool calls or on a repository change); 0.8.34: a separate model judges every work turn at Stop (critic gate, no API key), every-means-now (urgency).

plugins.name: ugot-writing
plugins.description: Reader-first writing (mainly Korean): style editing, applications, songs and lyrics, story craft, short-form ads, and CriticMarkup evidence notes on every claim (criticmarkup). Explaining with pictures moved to ugot-mindset (visual-first). Working-copy skill runs with per-requirement CriticMarkup notes (skill-run).

plugins.name: ugot-engineering-habits
plugins.description: Engineering habits for coding agents: build it right the first time, check the latest literature, disclose shortcuts, premortem before claims, use fundamental terms, consult on architecture, separate incident mitigation from the root fix; a mitigation (retry, rollback, backoff, raised limit) is closed only with the root fix in the same turn or an explicit stop.

plugins.name: ugot-career
plugins.description: Job applications for developers who work with AI coding tools: screen postings, dissect requirements, research the company, build a tailored resume and portfolio story, submit and track.
